phase: Phase 6 — Background Knowledge and Causal Constraints
objective: Create a domain-informed, temporally aware, treatment-specific constraint specification for later discovery; do not discover a DAG.

frozen_assumptions.patient_dependence: Retain SubjectID for repeated-patient dependence/clustering; it is not an ordinary causal node.
frozen_assumptions.repeated_ecgs: Repeated ECGs within an admission do not create independent causal units.
frozen_assumptions.phase1_conclusion: ECG time is not established as causal time zero; index ECG selection remains unresolved pending treatment timing.

frozen_assumptions.phase2_outcome_definition: UNRESOLVED — requires later causal outcome definition/audit.

frozen_assumptions.phase5_z_ecg: Causal role unresolved; not currently a confounder or baseline adjustment variable.
frozen_assumptions.phase0: No dedicated Phase 0 file was found in the project root; estimand/problem-definition wording remains unverified.
frozen_assumptions.phase5_z_ecg_linkage_finding: The master rows can be checked for study_id uniqueness and complete z_ecg columns.
